name: LinkedIn

L3.dsaDepth: Heavy - verbal reasoning matters as much as correctness; easy–medium LeetCode across two coding rounds
rounds: Technical phone screen (Coderpad/Collabedit, ~1 hr, 1–2 easy–medium problems: strings/arrays/binary search/trees) plus light behavioral
Optional take-home or async assessment (2 LeetCode-style problems) for some pipelines
Onsite/virtual loop (5–7 rounds): further coding, an SQL round, system design (told to keep it verbal, not whiteboard-heavy), hiring-manager/culture-fit conversation
Team matching (LinkedIn’s process is centralized - you interview before being matched to a team)
extraTopics: Explaining your logic out loud clearly - interviewers are reported to value verbal reasoning over silently arriving at a correct answer

L4 Senior.dsaDepth: Heavy - same format, system design and past-work defense weighted more
rounds: Similar loop to L3 with a heavier system-design round and hiring-manager conversation that probes trade-offs on past projects in depth
extraTopics: System design (verbal, not whiteboard - several candidates report being told to put away diagrams)
Defending past technical decisions in detail

L5+ Staff.dsaDepth: Moderate - coding present, system design and technical leadership dominate
rounds: Coding round(s), a deeper system design round, and leadership/scope-focused conversations
L5+ Staff.notes: Thinner public detail above L4; treat as indicative.
